Small business owners in South Florida:

Your competitors just got access to 24/7 AI phone agents.

They don't sleep. They don't miss calls. They book appointments while you sleep.

The businesses winning right now?
They're the ones who answer when customers call.

Even at 9 PM.

Even on Sundays.

AI = availability.

HVAC companies in Palm Beach Gardens:

90°F hits. AC breaks. Customer calls.

Voicemail = lost job.

One emergency job pays for a month of AI phone coverage.

The math is simple.
The execution is everything.

Question for service business owners:

What's your current call answer rate during business hours?

A) 90%+ - We answer almost everything
B) 70-89% - Most calls get through
C) 50-69% - We miss quite a few
D) Under 50% - We need help

Be honest. The data might surprise you.

Dental practices:

New patient calls at 6:15 PM.
You're with a patient.
Call goes to voicemail.

They don't leave a message.
They call the next practice on Google.

That just cost you $2,000+ in lifetime value.

For a call you didn't even know you missed.

The biggest myth about AI for small business:

'It's too expensive.'

Reality:
• One new client pays for months of AI
• One retained customer covers the cost
• 24/7 availability = competitive advantage

It's not a cost.
It's the cheapest insurance policy you'll buy.
